task: FV2-052 — Route active desktop microphone selection through LiveKit audio device module
summary: After the user reported that device choices appeared only after voice admission and changing the selected input did not work, inspection showed that the active LocalAudioTrack path rebuilt getUserMedia instead of switching the desktop LiveKit Audio Device Module route. Desktop now calls Room.setAudioInputDevice, updates the active track and room defaults, and resets native noise-suppression runtime state. Android/iOS retain the capture-restart path.

checks.command: cd clients/flutter && flutter test --no-pub test/audio_devices/input_selection_probe_test.dart --plain-name 'active desktop input switch uses the native LiveKit route'
checks.observation: Expected a FlutterWebRTC selectAudioInput method-channel call for the selected device; the active-track restart path emitted none.

checks.name: Audio selection and noise-state focused regressions after final change
checks.command: cd clients/flutter && flutter test --no-pub test/audio_devices/input_selection_probe_test.dart test/noise_suppression_settings_test.dart test/native_noise_suppression_test.dart
checks.observation: The desktop test confirms native selectAudioInput(deviceId), updates both current track options and room defaults, and does not recapture. Android/iOS capture-restart, mute preservation, pending state, and rollback tests pass.

The live Mac app cannot currently hot reload, and restarting it was avoided to prevent a Keychain prompt. FV2-052 remains open for current-source physical route acceptance in a debuggable session.
